selection_method: Seeded ordering within two previously retrieved Flowers-annotated pools, interleaved taxa; prioritized single-photo observations to make complete-photo review efficient. Historical pilot and current atlas observations excluded. All source photos and current public details refreshed. Convenience sample selected for usable flower evidence, not a population sample.
